csv_project_name: A/E for Franchise Tax Board 084 Fire Alarm Upgrades
csv_agency: DGS Real Estate Srvcs Div Construction Contracts
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of General Services (DGS), Project Management and Development Branch (PMBD) is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from Architectural and Engineering firms. The Fire Life and Safety upgrade at the Franchise Tax Board 084 includes the replacement of the entire fire alarm system in the 1.9 million square foot Franchise Tax Board buildings (084-01, 084- 2, 084-3 and 084-4). Fire pump replacement to the exiting fire sprinkler system. The fire alarm upgrade includes multiple fire alarm nodes, connected to multiple fire alarm panels. Fire sprinkler system upgrade includes replacement of the jockey pump and associated VFD s to maintain adequate water pressure in the sprinkler lines. Removal of the existing fire pumps and related equipment (piping, controllers, etc) from the boiler room. Install new fire pumps and related equipment outside of the boiler room in a new fire pump enclosure. The new fire pump enclosure requirements per code and 2019 NFPA 20 Requirements: lighting, emergency lighting, fire alarm, sprinklers, floor drain (plumbing), electrical outlet, temperature control (Low:40 F, High 104 F or per equipment manufacture requirements. Control temperature by exhaust fan, etc.) The successful firm shall provide professional architectural and engineering design, and additional services as required, for the above-referenced design-bid-build project. The services may include, but not be limited to, reports, preliminary plans, working drawings, cost estimates, bidding solicitation support, and construction support. All work shall be performed under and be approved by a design professional licensed in the State of California.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Fire Protection Engineering
